title: Package Profiles & Dependencies
summary: Installs the package profiles from config/package_profiles.json. Each profile shows its resolved package plan before anything is installed; failed required packages roll the profile back.

items.title: Proxy & Evasion Cores
items.description: Passwall wizard: Passwall-1 or Passwall-2, then Recommended or Custom package selection, review and deploy.
items.usage_tip: 0 on any wizard step goes back without installing.

items.title: VPN & Tunnels
items.description: Resolves and installs the VPN profile (WireGuard, OpenVPN and helpers).
items.usage_tip: Optional packages that fail only print a warning.

items.title: USB & Hardware Drivers
items.description: RNDIS, CDC-Ether, CDC-NCM and iPhone (ipheth + usbmuxd) tethering drivers, usbutils and usb-modeswitch.
items.usage_tip: Install this before using the Hardware & USB Tethering menu.

items.title: Network Tools & Traffic
items.description: mwan3, SQM and traffic tools, plus optional TPROXY kernel support for sing-box / Xray.
items.usage_tip: Needed for Multi-WAN and for tproxy engines.

items.title: Check & Update Installed Packages
items.description: Compares the packages DayPass installed with the available versions and upgrades them after confirmation.
items.usage_tip: Use it after a new DayPass release.

items.title: List Package Profiles
items.description: Prints every profile id with its title and description.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.usage_tip: Nothing is changed by leaving this menu.

items.title: Quit DayPass
items.description: Ends the DayPass session from any menu.
items.usage_tip: Ctrl+C does the same and restores the terminal.

items.title: Help
items.description: Opens the manual of the current screen.
items.usage_tip: Enter or 0 inside a manual returns to the screen you came from; q quits DayPass.
